title: Facilities Engineering Intern Mechanical
description:
Job Details:
Job Description:
The Role and Impact
As a Facilities Engineering Undergraduate Intern, you will play a key role in supporting the planning, implementation, and maintenance of Intel's cutting-edge building infrastructure and systems. You will engage in real-world projects that analyze operational processes, optimize energy usage, and ensure safety compliance. Your hands-on contributions will help improve efficiency and support facility expansion, directly impacting Intel's ability to operate effectively and innovate on a global scale.
Business group
You will join Intel Foundry, which drives innovation and operational excellence across Intel's manufacturing and facilities infrastructure. This group is dedicated to ensuring Intel's facilities meet the highest standards of performance, safety, and sustainability to enable groundbreaking technology advancements. As part of this collaborative and forward-thinking team, you will help shape Intel's future success while gaining valuable experience.
Key Responsibilities
- Assist in the planning, execution, and maintenance of facility infrastructure and systems.
- Analyze operational processes, energy consumption, and compliance with safety standards.
- Support facility layout design and expansion projects.
- Collaborate with engineering teams to identify opportunities for efficiency improvements.
- Learn and apply engineering concepts while contributing to projects that align with Intel's business goals.
Qualifications:
Minimum Qualifications
- Pursuing a bachelor's degree in mechanical engineering.
- Strong communication skills, both written and verbal, with the ability to work independently and collaboratively as part of a team.
- Enthusiasm for developing practical engineering solutions to support growth and innovation.
- Able to commit to a minimum internship period of 5 to 6 months, subject to university/college internship requirements and academic calendar.
We're looking for passionate individuals eager to explore their future careers and contribute to impactful projects in a dynamic and inclusive environment. Apply today to take the first step in building your career with Intel.
